shortDescription: Rretrieves information about applications installed with pipx

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to the C(pipx) installed in the system. If not specified, the module uses C(python -m pipx) to run the tool, using the same Python interpreter as ansible itself.

options.name: global
options.description: The module passes the C(--global) argument to C(pipx), to execute actions in global scope.

options.name: include_deps
options.description: Include dependent packages in the output.

options.name: include_injected
options.description: Include injected packages in the output.

options.name: include_raw
options.description: Returns the raw output of C(pipx list --json). The raw output is not affected by O(include_deps) or O(include_injected).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of an application installed with C(pipx).
